name: revenue_analysis
description: Generate a data-backed executive revenue narrative for any level of a product or segment hierarchy. Explains what happened (plan performance, growth rates, child breakdown), why (customer concentration, cohort analysis, geographic/industry mix), and what matters (risks, opportunities, structural outlook). Triggers: revenue summary, revenue narrative, revenue analysis, what drove revenue, revenue trends, QBR prep, executive summary, quarterly review, monthly revenue, explain the quarter, revenue deep dive, product category performance, segment performance, how is revenue doing, what is driving growth, revenue breakdown.
